quote: My 2007 Hilux carries my tools to every job. The loan rate feels high and I want a clear plan to finish paying it off without hurting the business.
context: Working truck on a used-vehicle loan; 27 payments left at 12.9%; credit improved

bestMove.title: Refinance to a lower rate, then use extra principal as the payoff plan
bestMove.message: At the simulated 5.9% rate your payment would be about $443 a month instead of $479, saving roughly $825 after the $150 fee over the same 27 months. Adding a little extra principal each month can bring the payoff date forward.
bestMove.whyNotOthers: Extending the term lowers the payment but costs more interest; optional service coverage is worth pricing later, but the rate matters more right now.
bestMove.guardrails: Estimate from a simulated rate; a final rate follows credit review. Insurer and local rules in Puerto Rico may differ from the mainland.
